name: Form Koi Free
free_limit: 250 form submissions per calendar month across unlimited forms in one workspace; searchable inbox, CSV export, spam protection, email delivery tracking, up to 5 verified recipients per form, consent-based auto-replies, signed webhooks and management API. Allowance resets on the first day of each month (UTC).
watch_out: Cloud-hosted form backend. Free submissions pause when the shared monthly limit is reached; no automatic overage billing. File attachments require Pro. Free auto-replies are limited to 20/hour and 100/day per workspace; service-wide safeguards apply. Free plan is described for portfolios, side projects and a client site or two; broader commercial rights should be independently confirmed.
